title: solo builds bypass model tiers: the build falls to the operator's session model
detail: drive's solo_handback (drive.py:414) hands the solo build back to the calling session, so P4 model tiers (v0.231.0) never apply: pinned-engine's solo build ran on opus (11.9M of 16.6M sprint tokens) because the operator session is opus. Team mode spawns tiered builders. Drive should run the solo build itself: create worktrees/solo on a declared branch (see fb-95d0c641cd90) and spawn a builder role resolved through tier resolve, then continue to reviewing.

resolution.verify: uv run python -m pytest tests/test_tiered_solo_builder.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
